name: 45-google-thought-signatures-image-model
description: Gemini 3 thought signatures with the config ON ('gemini.thoughtSignatures': true, the default) and an /-image/ model. Model 'gemini-3.5-flash-image'. (:577-597) First branch: a truthy message-level `signature` plus a string text part sets thoughtSignature to that signature (:582-583). Second branch, only for /gemini-3/: a functionCall without one gets the 'skip_thought_signature_validator' bypass (:586-588), and on an /-image/ model a model-role part that is text or inlineData gets the bypass too (:589-593). The two assistant turns merge (same role 'model'), so the functionCall lands beside the signed text part instead of in its own turn. The user-role image is NOT bypassed, because that branch requires role 'model', but it does get mediaResolution since detail is 'high'. Expected contents: [user[text], model[text+'SIG-A', functionCall+bypass], user[inlineData+media_resolution_high], model[inlineData+bypass, text 'look'+bypass]].
